In Finnegans Wake, Alp, anna livia pluabelle, the liffey returns to the sea to reunite with her father.

Anna Livia is a bronze monument located in Croppies Memorial Park in Dublin, Ireland. The monument is a personification of the River Liffey (Abhainn na Life in Irish) which runs through the city.
